items.title: How many genuine deposits does it actually take?
items.description: Illustrative model, not a measured curve: represents estimated willingness to help back as a function of how many genuine, low-cost deposits have accumulated — rising fastest with the first few, then leveling off, since trust doesn't need to keep compounding forever to be effective. Drag the slider to see how few deposits are actually needed before most of the benefit is already there.
items.compute: const estimatedWillingness = Math.round(100 * (1 - Math.exp(-params.numDeposits / 5))); return { estimatedWillingness };
